dct_title_s: Floodwater depth in Bula and Minalabac Municipalities, Camarines Sur Provinces of Philippines as of 1 November 2020
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20201101PHL** This map illustrates floodwater depth in Floodwater depth in Bula and Minalabac municipalities, Camarines Sur Provinces, Bicol Region (Region V) of Philippines based on surface waters observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 1st of November 2020 and a digital elevation model data with the floodwater depth estimation tool (FwDET). This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT. Important Note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to backscattering properties of the radar signal.
